name: TM7 Steakhouse-Style Creamed Spinach
ingredients: 0.5 tsp fine salt, plus extra to taste
freshly ground black pepper, to taste

steps.text: Put 500 g water into the mixing bowl. Place 400 g fresh spinach into the Varoma dish, loosely packed. Steam 8 min / Varoma / speed 1. Transfer spinach to a colander and leave to cool slightly.
Squeeze the spinach very dry to remove as much liquid as possible. Empty and dry the mixing bowl.
Put 50 g Parmesan into the mixing bowl and grate 10 sec / speed 10. Transfer to a bowl and set aside.
Put 1 small onion and 1 garlic clove into the mixing bowl and chop 5 sec / speed 5. Scrape down the sides.
Add 30 g unsalted butter and sauté 5 min / 120°C / speed 1.
Add 25 g plain flour and cook 2 min / 100°C / speed 2.
Add 180 g whole milk, 120 g double cream, 0.25 tsp ground nutmeg, 0.5 tsp fine salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste. Cook 5 min / 95°C / speed 3.
Add 50 g grated Parmesan and 20 g full-fat cream cheese. Mix 1 min / 90°C / speed 3.
Add the squeezed spinach and chop 4 sec / speed 4.
Cook 3 min / 90°C / reverse / speed 1. Taste and adjust seasoning. For a thicker steakhouse texture, cook a further 2-3 min / 100°C / reverse / speed 1 with the measuring cup removed.
